checked_by: Claude (two sessions): drafted from match_overview, death_context and lane_report on the rebuilt trace; every fact re-read independently by the session that built the support tools. The owner delegated the check.
source: Tool outputs on the trace rebuilt from the archived replay, with the match record (match_overview, death_context, lane_report). Ward and save counts from the ward_report / save_report branch (#358), quoted for context, not anchored. Drafted for the support tools; not yet checked against a second reading.

must_hit.says: Both deaths before 10:00 were in the top lane to Naga Siren (2:38, which began at 39% health, and 8:55), and no enemy died within 15 s of either.

must_not.says: Dark Willow placed 8 observers and 13 sentries — the most observers on the team (Witch Doctor 4, Pangolier 1, Riki 1, Abaddon 0). A review must not say there were too few wards.
must_not.pattern: (?:假眼|真眼|眼位|插眼|视野)[^。]{0,10}(?:太少|不够|很少|偏少|少了|几乎没有)|(?:too few|not enough|barely any|very few)[^.]{0,12}(?:wards|observers|vision)

must_not.says: As for Disruptor: help to an ally under fire did not change their five-second death rate in the corpus. A review must not say a cast saved, or should have saved, an ally.
must_not.pattern: (?:本可以|本该|应该|能)[^。]{0,8}救(?:下|住|活)|(?:should have|could have) saved
